profile.name: Jaenudin Suwandi
profile.heroHeadline: I turn production planning into smarter, data-driven operations with SAP ERP and Digital Solutions.
profile.heroBio: Hi, I'm Jaenudin Suwandi, a PPIC professional with 5+ years of manufacturing experience, specializing in production planning, MRP, inventory control, and SAP ERP — with a passion for building digital solutions that improve operational efficiency.
profile.differentiator: Combines 5+ years of operational supply chain expertise (SAP ERP, MRP, inventory control) with modern web development skills (Laravel, Filament Admin, Tailwind CSS, AI-Assisted Workflows) to build practical tools that solve real operational bottlenecks.

supplyChain.title: PPIC & Supply Chain Specialist
supplyChain.subtitle: Operations, SAP ERP & Inventory
supplyChain.description: Planning factory production lines, balancing capacity, running SAP MRP routines, and preventing costly material shortages across manufacturing operations.

developer.title: Full-Stack Web & Automation Developer
developer.subtitle: Laravel, Filament Admin & Systems
developer.description: Architecting bespoke web applications, custom management panels, and data automation scripts that empower non-technical teams and eliminate manual busywork.

projects.title: Corporate Web & Custom Admin Panel — Jumbo Bag Manufacturing
projects.summary: Built a complete company profile and custom management system for a heavy-duty industrial jumbo bag (FIBC) manufacturing business.
projects.challenge: Non-technical plant staff and sales representatives struggled to update technical specifications (Safe Working Load / SWL, loop configurations, discharge spouts) and handle disorganized quote inquiries through static spreadsheets.
projects.solution: Engineered a custom web application with Laravel 11 and Filament Admin v3, providing an intuitive dashboard for catalog management, specification updates, and structured RFQ inquiry handling.
projects.businessValue: Enabled non-technical staff to autonomously manage product catalogs and specifications with zero developer dependency, while cutting quote turnaround time to under 24 hours.

experience.description: Responsible for Master Production Scheduling (MPS), SAP MRP runs, material replenishment, and cross-department manufacturing synchronization.
bulletPoints: Formulate weekly and monthly Master Production Schedules (MPS) balancing manufacturing plant capacity and customer order demand.
Execute SAP ERP MRP cycles to optimize raw material inventory, batch sizing, safety stock levels, and multi-level BoMs.
Partner closely with Sales, Warehouse, Quality Control, and Production to uphold 98%+ On-Time In-Full (OTIF) fulfillment.
Spearheaded the planning and execution of expired returned paint reprocessing valued at >IDR 1 Billion in February 2025.

experience.description: Enforced enterprise data integrity across commercial, logistics, and financial modules in SAP while managing periodic inventory reconciliation audits.
bulletPoints: Ensured 100% synchronicity of transactional records between Sales orders, Warehouse movements, and Finance general ledger in SAP ERP.
Performed weekly master data governance on material valuations, batch tracking numbers, and storage locations.
Built automated Excel reporting models utilizing advanced Pivot Tables and lookup matrices to analyze daily stock discrepancies.

experience.description: Managed operational dispatching, multi-route logistical optimization, and technician task scheduling across regional ATM banking infrastructures.
bulletPoints: Optimized travel routes and task dispatching for engineering field teams under strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Monitored real-time incident resolution tickers to minimize ATM hardware downtime and banking service interruptions.

experience.description: Hands-on field engineering role executing first-line diagnostics, electronics repair, preventive maintenance, and cash dispenser systems.
bulletPoints: Diagnosed electromechanical and software faults on commercial automated teller machines (ATMs).
Conducted preventive maintenance routines to maintain 99%+ machine uptime across regional bank branches.

achievements.title: Outstanding Achievement in Product Reprocessing
achievements.description: Successfully planned and scheduled the conversion of expired returned paint batches into usable products, salvaging over IDR 1,000,000,000 in raw material value and eliminating inventory write-offs without impacting regular customer orders.

education.description: Strong foundation in software engineering, relational database management (RDBMS), algorithms, and systems analysis. This formal computer science background provides an unfair analytical advantage when configuring complex ERP systems and writing custom automation scripts.
